summary: All three files contain substantial formal mathematical content relevant to the Brauer group and related algebra. BrauerGroup/Azumaya/Basic.lean defines Azumaya algebra characterizations, Morita equivalence criteria, and matrix algebra instances. BrauerGroup/BrauerGroup.lean constructs the Brauer group as a commutative group, proves its group laws, defines base change functors, and establishes the category-theoretic framework. BrauerGroup/IsoSecond.lean develops the isomorphism between the relative Brauer group and Galois cohomology H², including cross product algebras, module constructions over tensor products, and explicit Brauer equivalence proofs. None are pure import aggregators, documentation-only, or duplicates; each contains unique definitions, statements, and proofs that should remain searchable.
